notes: The three *the*s of *the hands of the people of the land* are distributed by rule 29: the one present article takes the *the* before its own word and the two constructs take supplied ones.

אוֹתָם takes *unto* under rule 16's first family, since *do unto them* reaches the object through a preposition that exists only for that relation; the subtraction test leaves only the object relation diminished.
The closing clause writes אֲנִי, so it takes only *I* and the supplied *am* joins the predicate יְהוָה (rule 20).
